title: I am working on this EA For XAUUSD
author: nikhil7027
selftext:
[EA Backtested from 2024 to 2026](https://preview.redd.it/40vme9zk6ath1.png?width=1906&format=png&auto=webp&s=185c9a8c2f9681f8cd5244170deff799249dcb5e)

What's your take on this?

comments.author: CommandantZ
comments.body:
Professional EA developer here,

First thing that strikes is that the drawdown is too high for the results you are getting.

comments.author: dancrieg
comments.body: too few trades, too high drawdown

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: two years of gold that mostly went one direction is a hard sample to judge an EA on. run it through 2021 and 2022 when it chopped sideways. if it still holds up there it's worth paper trading for a while, if not you've learned it's a trend follower.

replies.author: nikhil7027
replies.body: Made some changes and then backtested 2021-2023 see updates please

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: good, 2021-2023 is the fairer test. with a weekly setup the catch is trade count though, three years is maybe a few dozen trades, so one or two big ones can decide the whole result. check how much of the profit sits in the top three.

replies.author: nikhil7027
replies.body: Best trade profit is 144usd in total 4 to 5 trades closed +100usd profits

replies.author: nikhil7027
replies.body:
It uses weekly rebalancing from 2months, 1month, 1 week and 1 days.   high and lows and trades from +4 to -4 numbering system as rebalancing is weekly so in 1 week only 2 to 3 trades at max sometimes 1 only depends on momentum and in ranging markets only small trades if system allows mostly flat or some drawdown 

Using 2R now with trailing stops on daily close basis

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: $144 over 4-5 trades is too few to tell an edge from a good week on gold. I'd wait for 30-50 closed trades and watch the worst one more than the best.

comments.body: Good start. Work on DD. For 70 trades only, that DD is too high. Also the number of trades are few to conclude the results.
